_about: RULEBOOK §10: the only way an EXISTING library version in a shared package's package.json (or an override in the root package.json) may change is a published security advisory recorded here. scripts/check-unified-fence.ts reads this file: a changed version passes only when this list names the same manifest, package and new range, with a GHSA advisory id. Add an entry in the same commit as the upgrade; never remove one (it is the record).

upgrades.why: SQL injection via improperly escaped SQL identifiers (<0.45.2)
quadratic-time CPU denial of service in Client.list() (<=6.2.0); transitive via puppeteer > proxy-agent > get-uri

memory exhaustion on oversized collections (zod 3). The shared code now runs under zod 3 (the CRM templates) and zod 4 (the unified app): see packages/tenant-backend/src/zodMessage.ts and partialOf.ts

open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (>=6.0.0 <7.18.0). The workspace's dev copy of the router moves with the unified app's, so shared screens and their tests see one router; the peer range (^6, what the templates install) is unchanged

removes the transitive zod 3.23.8: puppeteer 23 > chromium-bidi 0.11.0 pins zod exactly and no 3.x release has the fix; puppeteer 25 > chromium-bidi 157 uses zod ^4.6.5. It also drops extract-zip (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3): @puppeteer/browsers 3 unpacks with modern-tar
